blurb: Guests can enjoy curated tasting flights of handcrafted wines on the patio or in the tasting room. The winery hosts weddings from mid-May to mid-August for groups up to 100 guests. Special events and corporate bookings are also available throughout the year.
extraNote: Wine orders can be cancelled until shipment notification is sent · Wine Club shipments must be cancelled at least 10 business days before shipping date · No product returns accepted once wine leaves winery · Wedding bookings only from mid-May to mid-August · 2027 wedding season fully booked; 2028 bookings open October 2026
